error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Smart Life/Tuya. Try again.

abort.already_configured: This Smart Life account is already configured.

user.title: Connect Smart Life
user.description: Enter the User Code from Smart Life: Me → Settings → Account and Security → User Code. No Tuya IoT Developer account or cloud project is required.

scan.title: Authorize Eigen SmartLife
scan.description: Open Smart Life, scan the QR code below and approve access. Then return here and select Submit.

reauth_user_code.title: Reconnect Smart Life
reauth_user_code.description: Enter the current Smart Life User Code to authorize Eigen SmartLife again.
